name: miami
title: Miami
description: Ocean Drive at nightfall: art deco hotels with stepped parapets and neon trim, the glass towers of Brickell behind, still palms and neon reflections in the bay.

name: tokyo
title: Tokyo
description: Tokyo at dusk in coloured dots: Tokyo Tower glowing orange and white with both decks lit, a deep city fading into blue haze and a snow-capped Mount Fuji under an orange to indigo sky.

name: new-york
title: New York
description: Manhattan at dusk across the East River: the Empire State Building's lit spire, the Chrysler crown and One World Trade Center against an amber-to-blue sky, with soft window light, broken reflections and a slow ferry.

name: paris
title: Paris
description: Paris at blue hour in dots: the Eiffel Tower lit gold in a soft halo, Haussmann rooftops in blue shadow, the dome of Les Invalides in the last light, and the Seine holding the tower's long golden reflection.

name: london
title: London
description: Westminster at night across the Thames: the Elizabeth Tower with its lit clock, the Palace of Westminster, Tower Bridge and the Shard, with amber lamps on the embankment.

name: dubai
title: Dubai
description: Dubai at night from the water: the Burj Khalifa stepping up to its spire and beacon, the Emirates Towers, the Marina and the sail of the Burj Al Arab, with lit windows and calm reflections.

name: san-francisco
title: San Francisco
description: The Golden Gate Bridge at blue hour in halftone dots: Art Deco towers in International Orange catching the last light, fog rolling under the deck and over the Marin Headlands, city lights on the far shore and the bay mirroring the afterglow.

name: hong-kong
title: Hong Kong
description: Victoria Harbour at night from Kowloon: a wall of lit towers below the ridge of Victoria Peak, with Central Plaza, the Bank of China Tower and Two IFC, calm reflections and the Star Ferry.

name: rio
title: Rio de Janeiro
description: Rio de Janeiro at night from the sea: Sugarloaf with its cable car, Christ the Redeemer lit white on Corcovado, and the lamps of Copacabana on a calm bay.

name: sydney
title: Sydney
description: Sydney Harbour at night: the Opera House lit cream-white on its podium, the Harbour Bridge behind it, Circular Quay's towers and one ferry on calm water.
